_comment: Settings for a repo's reviewer session, on the launch line as --settings (agent-up.sh, a row of the roster's reviewers block). No hooks: a reviewer has no rung record, no gate and no STOP chain, and is not a row of the fleet block, so every fleet hook reads it as solo. The deny list is the one mechanical guard: it keeps the reviewer from posting, merging, committing or pushing. It drafts, the owner posts. Writes are denied by shape, not by where a flag stands: gh api with a method, a field or an input file anywhere on the line (a GraphQL read needs a field, so it is denied too: the reviewer reads through REST GETs and gh pr view, diff and checks); gh with -R or --repo before the subcommand, and git with -C, -c or another flag before push or commit; a shell wrapper (bash -c, sh -c, zsh -c, eval) that would hide the command. test-shape-up.sh runs the known bypass forms against these patterns. A form no pattern holds is still the reviewing-a-team-pr skill's rule.
